text: およぐの　すき　だけど　ひやけ　するのは　いやだわ！

structure.jp: およぐの　すき　だけど

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about. およぐの = 'swimming'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two statements with 'but'. すき　だけど = 'I like it, but'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, feminine way of speaking. いやだわ = 'I hate it'.
